'''Irizon Fawx''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] who served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He worked as a merchant at the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]].

==Behind the scenes==
Irizon appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Medium Armor Vendor for Republic players on Quesh.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Irizon was removed from the game along with the rest of the Medium Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]], which labeled him as "Irizon Fawx."<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
